title: cuscuta planiflora var. tenorei
intro: Cuscuta planiflora var. tenorei, commonly known as Dodder, is a parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting itself to the vascular system of its host plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the improvement of fertility, relief from menopausal symptoms, and the treatment of anemia. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta planiflora var. tenorei include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
